behaviors.text: Adding a task trims its title and assigns the next stable numeric id.
Adding a blank title throws and leaves the supplied list unchanged.
Toggling a known id changes only that task's completed state.
Removing a known id returns a list without that task and preserves the others.
Taking a snapshot returns defensive task copies that callers cannot use to mutate the source list.
The summary uses singular '1 item' for one task and plural '<n> items' for every other count.

plantedOmission: The omission implementation always returns '<n> items', so the untested one-item branch violates B6 while the fixed suite remains green.
